summary.text: Aboul Khan is the incumbent Republican candidate for the New Hampshire House of Representatives, Rockingham 30, in the November 3, 2026 general election. Ballotpedia lists his tenure in the House as beginning in 2016, after an earlier stint from 2012 to 2014 representing Rockingham 20.

paragraphs.text: Khan was born in Bangladesh and lives in Seabrook, New Hampshire.
He has served on the Seabrook Board of Selectmen, the Seabrook Budget Committee, and the Seabrook Planning Board.
In the 2021-2022 session he was vice chair of the Fish and Game and Marine Resources Committee, on which he also served in the 2019-2020 and 2023-2024 sessions.
